name: Nepal
about: Two trekking windows bracket the monsoon: autumn (Oct–Nov) has the clearest mountain views and is the busiest, spring (Mar–May) brings blooming rhododendrons; Jun–Sep monsoon brings leeches, landslide risk, and zero visibility.
overview: Eight of the world's fourteen highest peaks, the Everest Base Camp and Annapurna Circuit treks, and Kathmandu's ancient pagoda temples — the birthplace of high-altitude trekking tourism.
costOverview: Everyday food, tea, and local transport are extremely cheap — the real cost is the guided multi-day treks, which are essentially mandatory for the high routes.

costItems.label: Everest Base Camp trek package, guide & permits

specialSeasons.text: Monsoon season brings leeches, landslide risk, and zero mountain visibility — most trekkers avoid this window entirely.
